articles.headline: Ingolstadt sack pioneering female coach Sabrina Wittman
articles.description: Sabrina Wittmann, who in 2024 became the first female head coach in the top three men's football divisions in Germany, was fired Thursday after a rocky start to the season.

articles.headline: St. Pauli relegation 'anger' fueling Metcalfe at World Cup
articles.description: Socceroos attacker Connor Metcalfe says the "inner anger" from a frustrating Bundesliga campaign with St Pauli is helping to fuel his breakout FIFA World Cup.

images.name: Juan Jose Caceres and Connor Metcalfe [1296x729]
images.caption: Juan Jose Caceres and Connor Metcalfe
images.alt: Juan Jose Caceres and Connor Metcalfe

images.name: Metcalfe: 'A lot of inner anger from the season'
images.caption: Socceroos attacker Connor Metcalfe is enjoying the moment and the release of playing at the world cup after limited minutes at FC St. Pauli

articles.headline: Edin Dzeko leads Schalke to Bundesliga promotion at 40 years old
articles.description: Edin Dzeko returned in time for the celebrations as seven-time German champion Schalke sealed their return to the Bundesliga with a 1-0 win over Fortuna Düsseldorf on Saturday.

images.name: Dzeko Schalke celeb [1296x729]
images.caption: Schalke's Edin Dzeko and Kenan Karaman celebrate promotion to the Bundesliga in front of fans.
images.alt: Edin Dzeko and Kenan Karaman of FC Schalke 04 pose for a photo as they celebrate promotion to the Bundesliga in front of the fans after the team's victory in the 2. Bundesliga match between FC Schalke 04 and Fortuna DÃ¼sseldorf at Veltins-Arena on May 02,

images.name: Schalke [1296x729]
images.alt: Schalke players celebrate after the game.
images.credit: (Photo by Bernd Thissen/picture alliance via Getty Images)

articles.headline: Could Marie-Louise Eta be offered the permanent role at Union Berlin?
articles.description: Julien Laurens reacts to Marie-Louise Eta becoming the first woman to manage a men's Bundesliga team as interim.

images.name: Could Marie-Louise Eta be offered the permanent role at Union Berlin?
images.caption: Julien Laurens reacts to Marie-Louise Eta becoming the first woman to manage a men's Bundesliga team as interim.

articles.headline: German police investigate 'dangerous bodily harm' after fan trouble
articles.description: Police in Dresden have opened more than a dozen investigations into offenses, including causing "dangerous bodily harm" after large-scale disorder.

articles.headline: Borussia Dortmund names second-division exec as sporting director
articles.description: Borussia Dortmund has dipped into the German second division to appoint a new sporting director who won praise for making impactful transfers on a budget.

images.alt: Borussia Dortmund supporters show their support prior to the UEFA Champions League 2025/26 League Knockout Play-off First Leg match between Borussia Dortmund and Atalanta BC at BVB Stadion Dortmund on February 17, 2026 in Dortmund, Germany.
